entities.name: Chemerin-like receptor 2
observations: The 355-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed Macaca mulatta chemerin-like receptor 2 (UniProt O97664); alignment identity and coverage are 100%.
Human reference P46091 is 98.0% identical across the full query length.
The sequence contains a Pfam 7tm_1 GPCR domain spanning residues 55–304.
It is a plasma-membrane, multi-pass GPCR that signals mainly through beta-arrestin, with weaker G-protein, calcium, and ERK pathway responses reported for chemerin/RARRES2.
Reported ligands include chemerin/RARRES2 and TAFA1; the human receptor is also annotated as an HIV-1 coreceptor.
